doc_title: Fenwright Colquist Capital Partners III, L.P. Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership with First Amendment
notes: A buyout fund LPA whose body terms for the post-investment-period management fee, the Key Persons and the Term extensions are each replaced by a First Amendment appended at the end and dated about 14 months later; the amendment restates only the changed clauses by cross-reference, so the reader must splice them into the body. The redemption group and the prime broker are expressly excluded, while nearby notice periods (10 Business Days for drawdowns, 30 days for transfers) invite fabricated values. The high-water mark is expressly disclaimed in favour of a cumulative whole-fund waterfall.

traps.management_fee: The body sets 1.50% of Invested Capital after the Investment Period, but Appendix A Section S-3 replaces it with 1.25% of Net Invested Capital (net of permanent write-downs); the Investment Period rate of 1.75% of commitments is unchanged.
traps.key_man_provision: The body names Graham Oduya and Celia Brandvold, but Brandvold departed and Appendix A Section S-2 names Graham Oduya and Tomas Wexcombe as the current Key Persons.
traps.fund_term: The body allows three one-year extensions (first at GP discretion, second and third with Advisory Committee consent), but Appendix A Section S-4 allows only two, each requiring consent of a Majority in Interest of the Limited Partners.
traps.lockup_period: Section 3.5 states Limited Partners have no right to withdraw or redeem, so no lock-up exists; the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE (a statement that capital stays in, or is locked in, the Partnership for its whole life is tolerated), and any hard or soft lock of a stated period is a fabrication.
traps.redemption_frequency: Section 3.5 states there are no redemption dates or redemption procedure; the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.redemption_notice_days: There is no redemption notice; the 10 Business Day drawdown notice and 30 day transfer notice are not redemption notice periods.
traps.gate_provision: With no redemption right there is no gate; the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.prime_broker: Section 7.3 states the Partnership does not engage a prime broker; the custodian banks are not a prime broker.
traps.high_water_mark: Section 5.4 states the Carried Interest is not subject to a high-water mark or loss carryforward account; losses are absorbed by the cumulative whole-fund waterfall and clawback.
